name: Scopes Run
description: A collection_scope node is the statement about one collection run: what that run's credential was allowed to weigh in on. Exactly one per run, emitted before the run weighs in on anything. The target is tap_cares' core collection_job entity, addressed by its entity id — the scope is a github_core fact ABOUT a core run, never a field on it (github-core#145).
